Card Game POC.title: Card Game in Godot
Card Game POC.subTitle: A HSM character controller for Unity 3D
Card Game POC.briefDescription: A project written in C# and ran on the Unity game engine. Trying out a Hierarchical State Machine approach to implement an extensible character controller. Employing programming patterns such as state machines and observer patterns to create a working character movement system.

MapperMan.title: MapperMan
MapperMan.subTitle: MERN Stack map editing application
MapperMan.briefDescription: A MERN stack web application aimed at provided a map editing service online. Geared towards GeoJSON files as well as SHP/DBF files, MapperMan allows users to import, edit, and share their maps with others using MapperMan.
